title: Causal Modelling of Support Interventions for Student Competency Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2608.24632v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate assessment of student competencies is essential for enabling educators to identify individual needs, design targeted interventions, and evaluate the effectiveness of educational strategies. Empirical assessment procedures are typically grounded in psychometric models, such as item response theory, which relate student competence levels to performance on assessment tasks. In this paper, we advocate adopting a structural causal modelling approach to educational assessment, moving beyond probabilistic belief updating toward a framework that explicitly supports interventional and counterfactual reasoning. We propose a corresponding protocol for its construction and analyse the practical relevance of forms of reasoning that remain inaccessible to standard associative models, including the explicit modelling of interventions such as hints and the related counterfactual scenario analysis. translated_title: 学生能力评估中支持干预的因果建模
translated_abstract: 摘要：准确评估学生能力对于教育工作者识别个体需求、设计针对性干预措施以及评估教育策略的有效性至关重要。经验性评估程序通常基于心理测量模型，如项目反应理论，该理论将学生能力水平与评估任务中的表现联系起来。在本文中，我们主张在教育评估中采用结构因果建模方法，超越概率信念更新，转向一个明确支持干预和反事实推理的框架。我们提出了相应的构建协议，并分析了标准关联模型无法触及的推理形式的实际相关性，包括对提示等干预措施的明确建模以及相关的反事实情景分析。尽管我们的协议需要结构性假设，但它为教育评估提供了更丰富的推理能力。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于结构因果建模的教育评估新框架，支持干预和反事实推理，超越了传统心理测量模型的关联性局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel structural causal modeling framework for educational assessment, enabling interventional and counterfactual reasoning beyond the limitations of traditional associative psychometric models.
